rationale.formal-methods: Autoformalizes invariants and continuously verifies evolving AI-generated code.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Prototype uses syntactic checks, compilation, static analysis, and verifier engines.
rationale.remediation-gating: Formal constraints filter autonomous fixes and prevent regressions across iterations.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Developers approve specifications and proposed changes, or stop verification.
rationale.oversight-explanation: System explains specification impacts, benefits, trade-offs, and proposed changes.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Persistent specifications bound departures from accumulated developer intent.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Rapid iteration makes manual inspection, testing, and specification maintenance burdensome.
rationale.quality-debt: Targets constraint decay, duplication, inconsistency, churn, and technical debt.
